cohort: 1099 extremely low birth weight (ELBW) infants in South China
finding: The incidence of ROP and severe ROP in ELBW infants in South China from 2004 to 2018 was 50.7% and 29.9%, respectively, and only gestational age was statistically associated with ROP when controlling for other risk factors.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not statistically associated with retinopathy of prematurity in extremely low birth weight infants.
